what: a second edge flange picked on the bend line of an existing flange made a doubled flange with a gap and two shells in one body
method: the base's edge at y = 5 (the setback R + T = 5 from the first flange) is the bend line of the existing flange, not a free edge; a flange there would stand on material the first bend already occupies. The right behaviour is a clean refusal that leaves the sheet unchanged
